decisions.reason: As a flagship offshore management service closely aligned with the firm's core and strategic direction, it likely meets aspirations and is supported by organizational slack.
Though less central, it builds on established crew and travel operations and is retained while demand remains uncertain due to available slack.
As a flagship online portal supporting digitalization and customer retention, it is likely judged against strategic aspirations and remains worth carrying.
The mobile performance app complements core vessel management and fits the firm's digital service expansion, so it is kept despite some uncertainty.
